title: Letter About Travel Document
paragraphs: I am writing to confirm the travel document you need before the trip overseas next month. Your passport must be valid for at least six months, and you will also need a business visa from the local consulate.

The consulate representative told me that a visa application can take up to two weeks, so please contact the embassy office as soon as possible. Bring your invitation letter and passport photo for your visit.
For the flight, there is a short stop before the final connection. Remember to check the timezone difference so your immigration form is completed correctly on arrival.
Please let me know if you need any further help.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this letter?
options: To inform Owen about travel document needed for the trip
To invite Owen to a business conference
To request a refund for a flight

questions.stem: How long can a visa application take?
What should Owen bring when visiting the consulate?
options: A hotel confirmation and boarding pass
An invitation letter and passport photo
A signed contract and business card
A visa form and airline ticket only

questions.stem: Why does Grace remind Owen about the timezone difference?
options: Because the immigration form must be completed correctly on arrival
Because the flight has been delayed
Because the embassy office is closed on weekends
Because his passport is not valid anymore
